high_level_description: The image depicts a square ceramic tile with a vibrant and colorful floral design. The background of the tile is a bright green color, which serves as a striking contrast to the flowers and leaves painted on it. The flowers are stylized and appear to be sunflowers, characterized by their large, round centers with a grid-like pattern and multiple layers of petals in shades of pink and orange. The petals have a gradient effect, transitioning from a deeper pink at the center to a lighter pink towards the edges.
